text_block_list.text:
I constructed and executed what I
believed to be
the most effective plan
for victory...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
And yet it resulted in failure... Where
did I go
wrong?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I... I don't know how to proceed from
here...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: We can think of something together.
All you can do is keep running!

text_block_list.text:
I... I don't know how to proceed from
here...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: We can think of something together.
All you can do is keep running!

text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: It's okay to lean on me at times like this.

text_block_list.text:
You're right. I am not alone in my
efforts.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Besides, plans only improve each time
we address
their weak points!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
You'll find the answer as long as you keep
running.

text_block_list.text:
You are absolutely correct... There's no
use in
wallowing in despair and letting
myself spiral.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Continuing to run is the only way to
improve.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Trainer. Your
blunt honesty
has opened my eyes.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш lifts her chin up, ready to
face the
world head-on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
